priorities.goal: Improve responsiveness and frame stability without lowering certified visual quality.
Reduce duplicated logic, improve system contracts, and propagate verified good patterns across apps.
Increase animation smoothness, physical plausibility, transition quality, and directional consistency.
Improve geometry detail, PBR material readability, textures, microdetail, lighting, shadows, depth, atmospheric LOD, and stable high-quality rendering.
Make every improvement reproducible, testable, reversible, and reusable by future projects.
Adapt render cost to the device while preserving certified visual features and restoring quality automatically when pressure falls.
Reduce transfer, decode and memory cost with caching, compression, streaming and deduplication without destructive detail loss.

animationRules: Feet point in the movement direction when locomotion is active.
Attack and shooting direction stays consistent with character facing and feet.
Hand-held weapons remain attached to the correct hand; two-handed weapons remain controlled by both hands.
Shields remain in front of the torso when defending and maximize useful torso coverage.
When shield coverage can be measured, keep useful chest/abdomen coverage at or above the certified minimum.
visualRules: Never reduce existing certified visual detail to gain performance; prefer LOD, culling, batching, streaming and adaptive render scale.
Prefer high-detail near-field rendering and progressively cheaper distant rendering with atmospheric haze/fog where appropriate.
Preserve PBR separation between albedo, roughness, normal and displacement/detail channels.
Improve contact shadows, ambient occlusion, material variation, texture fidelity, lighting depth and physically plausible reflections.
Use subtle material wetness only where it improves readability and remains physically plausible for the scene.
deviceRules: Never claim real iOS temperature when no thermal sensor API is available; use sustained frame pressure only as a proxy.
Do not lower certified visual feature sets because a phone is slow; first lower render scale, distant LOD cost, particle density and streaming radius.
Restore quality upward with hysteresis after sustained recovery.
Treat Save-Data and low battery signals as power constraints where the browser exposes them.
assetRules: Cache heavy immutable 3D/audio assets separately from the app shell.
Detect exact duplicates and oversized hot-path assets automatically.
Prefer Meshopt/KTX2/Basis/WebP/AVIF/streaming where supported, but require visual evidence before destructive transcoding or simplification.
Keep source-quality masters available; optimize delivery copies rather than deleting masters.
automationRules: AI-generated patches must be verified in an isolated sandbox before application.
A candidate must pass the full release gate, deployed-preview Chromium and WebKit tests, and post-deploy smoke before PR creation.
Only low-risk source diffs may auto-merge; infrastructure/API/database/dependency changes always require review.
A failed production smoke must rollback the Vercel deployment and automatically prepare a code revert for a quiet self-improvement commit.
Run the quality convergence loop; a BLOCKED_UNRESOLVED state is never completion and must be repaired before delivery.
